rationale_one_line: React Doctor is a CLI verifier loop for coding agents, so the mono hacker-chic aesthetic with matrix-green accent matches the terminal-native voice of the project and Aiden Bai's lowercase build-in-public posting register.
writing_tone_notes: Lowercase. Terminal-native. Direct declarative beats with builder energy. No sycophancy. Honor the verifier-loop framing. Lean into shipping numbers like the 84k+ codebases scanned figure.
do_rules: Lead with the adversarial-loop framing. The agent ships, the doctor checks.
Keep type compact and monospaced. Hairlines stay thin.
Use matrix green accents only on the loud beat scenes.
Lowercase the headline and most copy to match Aiden's voice.
Treat scenes as terminal frames. Cut transitions, no fades.
dont_rules: No marketing softness. No sycophantic adjectives.
No corporate launch language. No vague wins.
No long sentences. The mono register punishes fluff.
